# A per-daemon queue block is refused, not merged. Three daemons each declaring
# "max_concurrent = 2" is not a budget of two — it is a budget of six wearing the
# word two, and it would read as correct in every individual config file.
env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$WORK/cfg
env BREEZE_DIR=$WORK/state
mkdir $WORK/cfg/breeze
mkdir $WORK/state

cp per-daemon.hcl $WORK/state/defaults.hcl
! exec breeze status
stderr 'MACHINE-wide|machine-wide'

-- cfg/breeze/defaults.hcl --
queue {
  max_concurrent = 4
}

-- per-daemon.hcl --
queue {
  max_concurrent = 2
}
